user_problem: Teams use the same metric name with inconsistent populations, time windows, and exclusions.
unique_output: A metric card specifying formula, numerator, denominator, population, window, exclusions, freshness, and unresolved choices.
test_case: Turn an ambiguous activation-rate note into a card that exposes missing time-window and eligibility definitions.
overlap_to_check: Weighted-rate audits, decision ledgers, and spreadsheet calculators.
specific_guardrail: Define a supplied product/operational metric without inventing definitions. Preserve missing/zero denominator policy, timezone/window and unknown populations; no financial or causal recommendations.
